# Test fixtures

`14-8646-5668.pbf.gz` is one z14 vector tile (x 8646, y 5668) covering the
centre of Ulm, including Ulm Minster, gzip-compressed. It was downloaded on
2026-11-22 from OpenFreeMap
(`https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet/20261115_080022_pt/14/8646/5668.pbf`,
OpenMapTiles schema 3.16, generated with Planetiler). It overlaps the OSM
extract in `packages/osm/test/fixtures/ulm-minster.osm`.
